about: Verdicts on Vietnamese clue fields, read by scripts/check-clue-whole.ts. A verdict is on the words (marks, joins and | are ignored), keyed by card id and field. ok: a person read the clue and it is a whole sentence. broken: a word was cut out; the text must not ship, and its count is the MAX_KNOWN_BROKEN_CLUES ratchet. See docs/clue-deleted-word-proposal.md.

entries.text: Hè này, tôi | ra hồ /trường_học/ sải mỗi=sáng.
entries.note: bơi cut; sải means nothing alone. Fixed in the pack.

entries.text: Cúp điện giữa giờ ôn, | cả phòng bật pin /điện_thoại/.
entries.note: đèn cut; bật pin means switch on the battery.

entries.text: Đi /dã_ngoại/, tôi | gói sẵn mấy ổ kẹp trứng.
entries.note: bánh_mì cut; the classifier ổ has no noun.

entries.text: /Đầu_kỳ/, | em ghi | đạt tám điểm Toán.
entries.note: mục_tiêu cut; ghi has no object.
